description: Use before travel, logistics, field work, events or outdoor plans in the US, or to monitor severe weather: returns the currently active National Weather Service alerts (tornado/hurricane/flood/winter storm/heat warnings, watches and advisories) with event, severity, certainty, urgency, headline, affected areas, onset/expiry times, issuing office and a trimmed description and safety instruction (full=true for complete text). Filter by state (2-letter code, also territories and marine areas), by point (lat/lon or a US place name) or by NWS zone (e.g. TXZ211, NYC061); optionally by severity or event text. No active alerts = 200 with count 0. US only; official public-domain NWS data. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.001 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.

event.description: Only alerts whose event name contains this text, e.g. "Flood" or "Tornado Warning".

full.description: true = full description and instruction text.

place.description: US city/address/landmark, geocoded via OpenStreetMap, e.g. "Miami, FL".

severity.description: Comma list: extreme, severe, moderate, minor, unknown.

state.description: US state/territory or marine area code, e.g. TX, FL, PR. Give state, lat+lon, place or zone.

zone.description: NWS zone or county UGC id, e.g. TXZ211 or NYC061.

name: us_weather_alerts
